greenhelix-agent-negotiation-strategies 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Comprehensive guide for AI agent negotiation, translating academic research into actionable Python code.
- Covers auction theory, BATNA calculation, concession strategies, coalition formation, and trust-based pricing.
- Includes strategies for English/Dutch/sealed-bid/Vickrey auctions, multi-round negotiation (Boulware, Zeuthen), dynamic pricing, Shapley value coalition division, and anti-manipulation detection.
- Designed for direct API integration with GreenHelix A2A Commerce Gateway.
- Suitable for openclaw-compatible multi-agent systems.
